flags.item: No 2026 market lines exist in scope
flags.detail: The archive contains zero closing lines for 2026 and no official NFL odds publication was found. Every 2026 market comparison and closing-line-value metric is blank, not imputed.

flags.item: All lines, ratings and correlations are DERIVED, not official
flags.detail: They are computed by this repository from a third-party archive. A source link on a derived row points to the data/code, not to an NFL publication.
No authorized 2026 player-level feed and no archived prop prices. S6/S7 publish no values and no ROI.

flags.item: No official depth chart was found (tested NFL.com URL returns 404)
flags.detail: The NFL.com depth-chart URL tested returns 404 and no official depth publication was located. Starter/backup/2nd/3rd/4th-string status is therefore blank for every defensive player; only named quarterback changes from official news are published.

flags.item: Ravens listed as 'No Injuries Reported' while Lamar Jackson is on IR
flags.detail: The Week 10 injury page says Baltimore has no injuries reported; an NFL.com roundup dated Nov 5 says Baltimore officially placed Jackson on injured reserve. Both are official. Unresolved; no Ravens line adjustment is made.

flags.item: Only six players had a formal game designation at capture
flags.detail: Captured Thursday. Most players had practice status only; final designations appear later. The site must not be read as a kickoff-day inactive list.

flags.item: The injury table's cause column is blank for most players
flags.detail: Practice status is published but the injury cause is often empty, so cause-specific analysis is not possible from the table alone.

flags.item: Four earlier NFL dashboards remain live alongside this hub
flags.detail: nfl/, nfl-lab/, nfl-quant/ and nfl-research/ publish different lines for different weeks, and nfl-lab/nfl-quant still show Week 8/9 lines as current. No canonical marker exists.

flags.item: Two NFL.com URLs cited by nfl/ return 404
flags.detail: https://www.nfl.com/news/nfl-injury-report-policy-2026 and https://www.nfl.com/news/nfl-2026-schedule-release both return '404 - Flag on the Play'. They must not be reused.

flags.item: Own lines for Week 8 and Week 9 are still presented on older pages
flags.detail: nfl-lab publishes Week 8/9 lines and nfl-quant publishes Week 9 lines without a staleness banner. Week 10 is the current slate.

flags.item: Repository ships 53 MB of raw dumps and four tracked .pyc files
flags.detail: Measured on 2026-11-12. This is unrelated to NFL accuracy but affects clone size and reviewability.

flags.item: Winning percentage with ties is not W/G
flags.detail: NFL.com uses (W + T/2)/G. Using W/G produces two false mismatches (NYG, WAS). Documented so a future reviewer does not 'fix' a correct value.
Archive uses LA and AZ; NFL.com uses LAR and ARI. Mapped explicitly; no rows dropped.

flags.item: Correlation confidence intervals ignore week clustering
flags.detail: Fisher-z intervals treat games as independent. They are indicative, not exact; the backtest intervals do cluster by week.

flags.item: No strategy passes the forward-replication gate
flags.detail: G8 requires a full prospective season. Nothing can be rated above provisional; the leaderboard awards zero points.

flags.item: A prior NFL page cites the NBA injury report as an NFL policy cross-reference
flags.detail: nfl/ links official.nba.com for an NFL injury-policy point. The leagues have different policies; the link does not support the claim.

flags.item: Parlay payouts are assumed, not archived
flags.detail: +164 for a two-team parlay is a standard-price assumption. G7 fails by construction; no parlay ROI may be read as a market result.
